title: Page 4
content_zh:
穷一点的人，可以选择买便宜一点的布料，布料的质量虽然不是上好，却依旧实用耐穿，做工扎实，完全不偷工减料；寻常人家就可以买中等布料，不会太过昂贵，穿起来也非常体面；而富有的人就可以选择最精致的布料。
就因为如此，无戚布庄的客人遍布京城，不过光这样还不足以让无戚布庄成为京城第一，真正让它成为第一的，其实是身为布庄专属画师的梁家兄妹。
京内有不少达官贵人喜欢向无戚布庄订制独一无二纹样的布疋、礼服等等，在知道客人的需求之后，画师就会绘制图样，再将图样交给布庄内附设绣坊里绣工最精巧的绣娘，把图案忠实呈现，世上再也找不到第二疋一样的绣花布疋。
三年前的画师是梁昭旭，因为画图是梁昭旭最爱的兴趣，又遇到戚无烟赏识他的画，因此他愿意在管理自家粮行生意之外的空闲时间帮布庄画图稿，两人合作愉快。
在梁昭旭死后，梁昭颖就代替了这个位置，她在哥哥身边耳濡目染，也画了一手好图，他们兄妹的画都有一种独特的繁复华丽美感，其它人很难学得来，所以便成为无戚布庄最大的特色，无人能及。
而布庄所专属的画师到底是谁，除了戚无烟以及关系深厚的家人属下们知道之外，其它人都不清楚，各家布庄都在打听这个秘密，希望能把这个神秘画师招揽过去，替自己赚钱。
看完梁昭颖带过来的画，戚无烟谨慎地收起来，对她赞赏一笑。“昭颖，辛苦你了。”
这幅鸳鸯戏水图是某位高官为即将出嫁的女儿订下的锦被样式，要当作嫁妆之一，不过高官只给非常短的时间制作，为了让绣娘能有充裕的时间绣图，梁昭颖只能连着好几天熬夜绘图，才能顺利地赶上制作进度。
他看得出来，她的眼下有抹淡淡的黑影，那肯定是熬夜熬出来的，她平日要管粮行的事情，晚上又要熬夜帮布庄赶画稿，将她给累坏了，他可是会心疼不忍的。
他冲动地伸出手，想摸摸她眼下那让人心疼的暗影，却突然觉得这么做似乎有些不妥，立刻又收了回来，放弃这样的举动。
“这没什么，我已经很习惯了。”她笑笑地回答，她和哥哥一样喜欢画图，所以熬夜赶画稿对她来说并不算什么，况且如果没有这一层关系，她也就没有理由常常接近他，甚至和他单独相处。
就算对他来说，这只是在工作，但对她来说，这却不只是工作，还有……她想单独拥有他的私心。
“对了，无烟哥，三天之后我要去探望哥哥，你要一起去吗？”那一天是哥哥的祭日，她每年都会去墓前探望哥哥。
“当然。”戚无烟当然知道这件事，而他也和她一样，都不曾缺席过，立刻爽快地答应。
三天后，戚无烟和梁昭颖一起到城外近郊的梁昭旭坟前，虔诚地来探望他。
“哥，我和无烟哥来看你了。”
一来到坟前，梁昭颖马上殷勤地开始整理起来，花了一些时间才把墓地打理完毕，然后放上梁昭旭生前最喜欢的几样菜，蹲在墓碑前，开心地和哥哥说起话来。
“哥，你最近好吗？有没有向阎王大老爷要一副没病没痛的好身子，然后开心地投胎去了？你不必放不下我，我早已经不是孩子，可以独当一面了……”
梁昭颖絮絮地说着，也不管自己的哥哥到底听不听得到，而戚无烟总会静默地陪在一旁，看着她强装开朗的神色，内心隐隐约约感到有些……刺痛。
这些年来，她似乎已经习惯用夸张的笑容武装自己，不让自己显露任何一点脆弱的模样，她好像以为只要这么做，什么事情就都无法打倒她，她可以坚强地生活下去。

她会变成现在这个样子，其实和她的娘梁秦氏非常有关系，她们母女俩的心结因梁昭旭而生，他一死，那道结就像被打死了一样，很难化解得开。
他很想帮她们母女解开这个心结，但总是心有余而力不足，母女俩的关系始终非常疏远，让他无可奈何。
初冬的冷风一吹，让穿得有些单薄的梁昭颖打了一个冷颤，戚无烟看到便赶紧解下自己身上的披风，不让她有染上风寒的机会。
“昭颖，你怎么总是这么不爱惜自己的身体，明明知道现在已经入冬了，却不多加几件衣裳？”她始终像是个不会照顾自己的孩子一样，总让他不得不花多一点心思来关心，连一点小细节都不忽略。
他亲手将披风披上她的肩，绑好系带，完全不容她拒绝，他无法抚慰她受伤的心，至少也要把她的身体给顾好，才不会辜负了好友所托。
看着她始终只留到肩头的发丝，他的眼神微黯，感到非常可惜，其实他很想再见见当年她留长发时的模样，那我见犹怜的气质，总是让他一想起就有种莫名的悸动，真是无比的怀念。
只可惜，似乎回不去了……
梁昭颖一被披风给紧紧包住，属于戚无烟的温暖气息便环绕着她，让她的心头瞬间涌出一股暖意，还有羞涩的甜意。
这种感觉，就好像他亲自将她给拥入怀中一样，但这是不可能的事情，所以她只能自己偷偷想象，不知道什么时候才会有成真的一天。
因为，他之所以会对她这么好，全是因为哥哥的托付，所以他总是以哥哥的心态在对待她，只把她当妹妹看。
经过了这三年，不知他的心态有没有任何改变，她……能不能有另外的期待？“无烟哥，我可以问你一件事吗？”她内心有些期待，试探地问。
“什么事？”
“你对我的照顾，只因为哥将我托付给你，所以将我当成妹妹看待，难道没有其它的吗？”
“呃？”他一愣，完全回答不出话来。
从以前到现在，他从来就没想过这个，当他决定要照顾她，就一心一意地认真照顾下去，如果不是她今天这样一问，他可能永远都不会思考这件事。
而这件事情很要紧吗？除了当她像妹妹一样的对待之外，她对他而言的确不同于一般女人……但那种特别到底是什么，他也难以形容……
“……布庄的合作关系？”因为回答不出来，他只好随意找个答案敷衍。
“算了，当我没问过这个问题。”她没好气地转过头，对着哥哥的墓碑自己一个人生起闷气，早该知道问不出什么好回答的，却还是忍不住替自己找罪受。
他果然只把她当成好友需要照顾的妹妹看待，除去这一点，她在他心中，根本没有任何地位，什么都不是。
好讨厌的感觉，真是该死的什么都不是！

第2章(1)
这些年来，只要一到冬天，她总是会梦到那一晚的事情，那不只是她的记忆，更是她甩不开的梦魇，或许到死都没办法摆脱一一寂静的夜，庄严肃穆的灵堂前，只有两名身穿白衣的母女守着灵堂，气氛是无比的冷清寂寥。
梁秦氏看着儿子的牌位，不由得悲从中来，走过丧夫之痛，她现在又得面对丧子之痛，这教她怎么忍受得了？她对不起梁家列祖列宗，她没能好好保下梁家唯一的香火，往后她到九泉之下也没脸见丈夫，梁家会后继无人，她脱离不了照顾不周的责任。
“旭儿……”梁秦氏落泪泣喊，在寂静的夜里显得更是凄楚，让人闻之鼻酸。
content_en:
Poorer people can choose to buy cheaper fabrics. Although the quality of the fabrics is not high, it is still practical and durable, with solid workmanship and no cutting corners at all. Ordinary people can buy mid-range fabrics, which are not too expensive and look very decent to wear. Rich people can choose the most exquisite fabrics.
Because of this, Wuqi Boutique has customers all over the capital. However, this alone is not enough to make Wuqi Boutique the number one in the capital. What really makes it the number one is actually the Liang brothers and sisters who are the exclusive painters of Boutique.
There are many dignitaries in Beijing who like to order unique patterns of cloth, dresses, etc. from Wuqi Cloth Shop. After knowing the customer's needs, the painter will draw a pattern, and then hand the pattern to the most exquisite embroiderer in the embroidery workshop attached to the cloth shop. The pattern will be faithfully presented, and there will never be another embroidered cloth like it in the world.
The painter three years ago was Liang Zhaoxu. Because drawing was Liang Zhaoxu's favorite hobby, and he met Qi Wuyan who appreciated his paintings, he was willing to help the cloth shop draw drawings in his free time outside of managing his own grain store business. The two of them cooperated happily.
After Liang Zhaoxu's death, Liang Zhaoying took over this position. She was closely influenced by her brother, and she also drew good pictures. The paintings of their brothers and sisters all have a unique complex and gorgeous beauty, which is difficult for others to imitate, so it has become the biggest feature of Wuqi Buzhuang, which no one can match.
As for who the exclusive painter of the cloth shop is, except for Qi Wuyan and his close family members, no one else knows. Every cloth shop is inquiring about this secret, hoping to recruit this mysterious painter to make money for themselves.
After reading the paintings that Liang Zhaoying brought over, Qi Wuyan carefully put them away and smiled appreciatively at her. "Zhaoying, thank you for your hard work."
This picture of mandarin ducks playing in the water was a brocade quilt style ordered by a senior official for his daughter who was about to get married. It was to be used as part of the dowry. However, the senior official only gave a very short time to make it. In order to allow the embroiderer enough time to embroider the picture, Liang Zhaoying had to stay up late for several days to draw, in order to smoothly catch up with the production progress.
He could see that there was a faint dark shadow under her eyes, which must have come from staying up late. She had to take care of the food store on weekdays, and at night she had to stay up late to help Buzhuang catch up on the drawings. She was exhausted, and he would feel sorry for her.
He impulsively stretched out his hand, wanting to touch the distressed shadow under her eyes, but suddenly felt that it seemed inappropriate to do so, and immediately took it back, giving up such a move.
"It's nothing, I'm very used to it." She replied with a smile. She likes drawing as much as her brother, so staying up late to catch up on drawings is nothing to her. Besides, without this relationship, she would have no reason to be close to him often, or even spend time alone with him.
Even if for him, it was just work, for her, it was more than just work, there was also...she wanted to have his selfishness alone.
"By the way, Brother Wuyan, I'm going to visit my brother in three days. Do you want to go with me?" That day was her brother's memorial day, and she would visit her brother at his grave every year.
"Of course." Of course Qi Wuyan knew about this, and like her, he had never been absent, so he immediately agreed readily.
Three days later, Qi Wuyan and Liang Zhaoying went to Liang Zhaoxu's grave in the suburbs outside the city to visit him devoutly.
"Brother, Brother Wuyan and I are here to see you."
As soon as she arrived at the grave, Liang Zhaoying immediately started to tidy it up diligently. It took her some time to finish the tomb. Then she put in some of Liang Zhaoxu's favorite dishes before she was alive. She squatted in front of the tombstone and talked happily with her brother.
"Brother, how have you been lately? Have you asked the Lord of Hell for a good body with no disease or pain, and then happily reincarnated? You don't have to let me go, I'm no longer a child, I can take care of myself..."
Liang Zhaoying talked nonchalantly, not caring whether her brother could hear it or not.When she arrived, Qi Wuyan would always be by her side silently. Seeing her forced cheerful expression, she felt a little... tingling in her heart.
Over the years, she seems to have become accustomed to arming herself with exaggerated smiles to prevent herself from showing any vulnerability. She seems to think that as long as she does this, nothing can defeat her and she can live a strong life.
The reason why she became like this is actually closely related to her mother, Liang Qin. The knot between mother and daughter was born because of Liang Zhaoxu. Once he died, the knot was as if it had been beaten to death, and it was difficult to resolve.
He really wanted to help mother and daughter untie this knot, but he was always unable to do so. The relationship between mother and daughter was always very distant, leaving him helpless.
The cold wind of early winter blew, making Liang Zhaoying, who was a little thinly dressed, shiver. When Qi Wuyan saw it, he quickly took off his cloak to prevent her from catching the cold.
"Zhaoying, why do you always care so little about your body? You know it's already winter, but you don't put on more clothes?" She always seemed like a child who didn't know how to take care of herself. She always made him have to spend more time to care about her, not even ignoring the small details.
He put the cloak on her shoulders and tied it with his own hands, not allowing her to refuse at all. He could not soothe her hurt heart, but at least he had to take good care of her body so that he would not let down his friend's trust.
Looking at her hair that only reached her shoulders, his eyes dimmed slightly, and he felt very sorry. In fact, he really wanted to see her again when she had long hair. Her pity for her temperament always made him feel inexplicable when he thought about it. He really missed her so much.
It's a pity that it seems I can't go back...
As soon as Liang Zhaoying was tightly wrapped in the cloak, Qi Wuyan's warm breath surrounded her, making her heart instantly feel warm and shyly sweet.
This feeling was as if he had held her in his arms, but this was impossible, so she could only secretly imagine it, not knowing when it would come true.
Because the reason why he was so kind to her was all because of his brother's entrustment, so he always treated her with the mentality of a brother and only regarded her as a sister.
After these three years, I wonder if his mentality has changed at all. Can she... have other expectations? "Brother Wuyan, can I ask you something?" She asked tentatively with some expectation in her heart.
"What's the matter?"
"The only reason you take care of me is because my brother entrusted me to you, so you treat me like a sister. Is there nothing else?"
"Huh?" He was stunned and completely speechless.
From before to now, he had never thought about this. When he decided to take care of her, he took care of her wholeheartedly. If she hadn't asked her like this today, he might never have thought about it.
And is this matter important? In addition to treating her like a sister, she is indeed different from other women to him... But what is that specialness, he can't describe...
"...Buzhuang's cooperative relationship?" Since he couldn't answer, he had to find an answer at random.
"Forget it, just pretend I didn't ask this question." She turned her head angrily and started sulking alone in front of her brother's tombstone. She should have known that there was no easy answer to the question, but she still couldn't help but find fault for herself.
As expected, he only regarded her as his friend's sister who needed to be taken care of. Apart from this, she had no status at all in his heart and was nothing.
What a disgusting feeling, it’s like damn nothing!
Chapter 2(1)
Over the years, whenever winter comes, she will always dream about that night. It is not only her memory, but also a nightmare that she cannot get rid of. Perhaps she will not be able to get rid of it until her death. In the silent night, in front of the solemn mourning hall, there are only two people wearing white clothes.Yi's mother and daughter guarded the mourning hall, and the atmosphere was extremely deserted and lonely.
Liang Qin looked at her son's memorial tablet and couldn't help but feel sad. After experiencing the pain of losing her husband, she now had to face the pain of losing her son. How could she endure this? She felt sorry for the ancestors of the Liang family. She failed to preserve the only incense of the Liang family. In the future, she would not be able to see her husband even if she was under Jiuquan. The Liang family would have no heirs. She could not escape the responsibility of poor care.
"Xu'er..." Mrs. Liang Qin cried out in tears, which seemed even more miserable in the silent night, making people feel sour.
